project.name: BAHRAIN BRICK GRAPHICS UPGRADE v1.0
project.objective: Reproduce the accepted Bahrain Brick art direction and premium mobile presentation while preserving frozen gameplay, controls, mission behaviour, asset authority, and PR #59.

requirements: PR #59 remains open, draft, unmerged, and unchanged at its frozen head.
Protected movement, touch, vehicle, mission, regression, and asset authorities remain unchanged.
Renderer authority is selected only from paired scene and Android device evidence.
No large graphics asset batch is ingested before G0 passes.
All new production assets have recorded rights and provenance.
Visible branding is eventually canonicalised to BAHRAIN BRICK without changing package identifiers unless separately approved.

decisions.decision: Use a child branch based on the exact PR #59 head; never push graphics changes to PR #59.
Keep renderer state UNRESOLVED until paired runtime and physical-device evidence exists.
Treat scripts/world.gd as protected until the missing _exit_tree authority inconsistency is resolved.
Block all cosmetic phases and large asset ingestion while G0 is open.

assumptions: The existing composite authority JSON remains the byte-hash source of truth for protected mobile controls.
The API 34 x86_64 emulator is a required diagnostic target but cannot replace physical-device performance acceptance.

risks.description: Renderer selection without device evidence could invalidate shaders, performance targets, and Android compatibility.
The design protects scripts/world.gd::_exit_tree, but that symbol is not visible in the inspected frozen head source.
No baseline screenshots or frame/memory/package measurements are attached to the frozen head.
No named minimum, target, or high-end physical devices and GPU drivers are assigned.
The current splash, main menu, and world loading UI duplicate runtime styling and simulated progress behaviour.

defects.description: Protected world.gd::_exit_tree symbol authority cannot be reconciled against inspected PR #59 head source.
